---
title: "Render the Documents"
---

1. Restore the R package library once per machine: run `renv::restore()` from the project root.
2. From the project root, run:

   ```
   quarto render
   ```

   To render a single document, pass its path, for example `quarto render reference/glossary.qmd`.

3. HTML output goes to `docs/`. Commit the regenerated files with your source changes.

The documents that are rendered are listed in `_quarto.yml`. When you add a document, place it in the Diátaxis folder that matches its purpose (`how-to/`, `reference/`, or `explanation/`), then add it to the map in `index.qmd` and to the layout in `README.md`.

When you rename or delete a document, also delete its old HTML file from `docs/`. Quarto does not remove outputs for documents that no longer exist.
